description: This file defines the Routes class for Drupal's JSON:API module, responsible for generating dynamic routing configurations for JSON:API resources, including resource collection, individual resource, relationship, and file upload routes, as well as route management utilities.

classes.name: Routes
classes.description: A class that defines and manages dynamic JSON:API routes within Drupal, including resource collection, individual resource, relationship, and file upload routes, with utilities for route naming, parameter management, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of Routes using the dependency injection container.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Generates and returns the collection of all JSON:API routes, including resource, upload, and entry point routes, with appropriate requirements and defaults.

methods.name: getRoutesForResourceType
methods.description: Generates route collection for a specific resource type, including collection, individual, and relationship routes.

methods.name: getFileUploadRoutesForResourceType
methods.description: Generates file upload routes for a specific resource type if applicable.

methods.name: isJsonApiRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request is for a JSON:API route based on route defaults.

methods.name: getIndividualRoutesForResourceType
methods.description: Creates routes for individual resource operations like get, patch, delete, and relationships.

methods.name: getEntryPointRoute
methods.description: Provides the route for the JSON:API entry point.

methods.name: addRouteParameter
methods.description: Adds or overrides a parameter option in a route.

methods.name: getRouteName
methods.description: Generates a unique route name for a resource type and route type.

methods.name: getFileUploadRouteName
methods.description: Generates a unique route name for file upload routes for a resource type.

methods.name: hasNonInternalTargetResourceTypes
methods.description: Checks if an array of resource types contains any non-internal types.

methods.name: hasNonInternalFileTargetResourceTypes
methods.description: Checks if an array of resource types contains any non-internal 'file' resource types.

methods.name: getResourceTypeNameFromParameters
methods.description: Extracts the resource type name from route parameters if the route is a JSON:API route.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Invalidates JSON:API resource type cache and triggers route rebuild.
